about: Bonvoyage protocol v1 test vectors. All binary values are base64url without padding. See README.md.

contact_checks.note: The recipient has ONE contact, created from `contact_card`, not yet paired. Handle these in order.

steps.why: valid message from a stranger: the pairing secret matches no contact
the pairing secret matches: the sender is paired and pinned
same signing key and id as the previous message: a repeat
right pairing secret, but the contact is already pinned to another key: the card leaked
the pinned sender: the pairing secret is no longer looked at
authentic, but an unknown message type is dropped without printing

base64url.note: AR decodes to the same byte as AQ, and AQJ to the same bytes as AQI, but with non-zero unused bits.
